citation: Kristensen K, Nielsen A, Berg CW, Skaug H, Bell BM. TMB: Automatic Differentiation and Laplace Approximation. Journal of Statistical Software 70(5).
specific_support: Describes TMB's joint likelihood specification, automatic differentiation, and Laplace integration over latent random effects; supports implementation and approximation context.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Does not establish accuracy or calibration for every drmTMB family, provider, or SD-regression parameterization.

citation: Brooks ME et al. glmmTMB Balances Speed and Flexibility Among Packages for Zero-inflated Generalized Linear Mixed Modeling. The R Journal 9(2):378-400.
specific_support: Documents a TMB-based GLMM implementation with flexible distributions and random-effect structures; useful architectural precedent.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Software precedent is not validation of drmTMB's interfaces, likelihoods, or proposed scale regression.

citation: glmmTMB developers. Covariance structures with glmmTMB. Official package vignette.
specific_support: Shows supported structured covariance parameterizations and how formula/model-matrix coding affects random-effect dimensions.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Describes glmmTMB semantics; it does not establish compatibility or correct scaling for drmTMB providers.

citation: Hedeker D, Mermelstein RJ, Demirtas H. An application of a mixed-effects location scale model for analysis of Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) data. Biometrics 64(2):627-634.
specific_support: Demonstrates covariates influencing mood variability and a subject-level random effect in a within-subject variance specification.
limitation_for_drmTMB: One Gaussian EMA setting; does not prove identifiability or performance across drmTMB response distributions and latent structures.

citation: Hedeker D, Nordgren R. MIXREGLS: A Program for Mixed-Effects Location Scale Analysis. Journal of Statistical Software 52(12).
specific_support: Presents log-linear covariate models for between- and within-subject variance components and random scale effects in conditionally normal responses.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Gaussian/conditionally normal model scope and estimation details differ from generalized response families and drmTMB's provider architecture.

citation: Joe H. Accuracy of Laplace approximation for discrete response mixed models. Computational Statistics & Data Analysis 52(12):5066-5074.
specific_support: Compares Laplace and adaptive Gauss-Hermite approximations across binary, ordinal, and count mixed models; reports regime-dependent estimator bias and improved accuracy from more quadrature points in studied cases.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Results cover selected models and designs, not a universal ranking or error bound for every drmTMB cell.

citation: Pinheiro JC, Bates DM. Approximations to the Log-Likelihood Function in the Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Model. Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics 4(1):12-35.
specific_support: Compares likelihood approximations including Laplace and Gaussian quadrature for nonlinear mixed-effects models.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Older nonlinear mixed-effects settings; not direct evidence for current TMB implementations or all structured providers.

citation: Stringer A. Exact Gradient Evaluation for Adaptive Quadrature Approximate Marginal Likelihood in Mixed Models for Grouped Data. arXiv:2310.01589.
specific_support: Studies adaptive quadrature for grouped Bernoulli mixed models and reports improved accuracy/coverage over Laplace in selected many-small-group, high-heterogeneity scenarios.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Preprint and model-specific; its coverage results do not transfer automatically to other response families or covariance structures.

citation: Sinha SK. Bootstrap tests for variance components in generalized linear mixed models. Canadian Journal of Statistics 37(2):219-234.
specific_support: Examines parametric bootstrap testing of a zero variance component and finite-sample level compared with asymptotic alternatives.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Supports boundary-aware testing checks only; does not establish confidence-interval coverage for SD-regression coefficients.

citation: Self SG, Liang KY. Asymptotic Properties of Maximum Likelihood Estimators and Likelihood Ratio Tests Under Nonstandard Conditions. Journal of the American Statistical Association 82(398):605-610.
specific_support: Derives nonstandard limiting behavior when the true parameter lies on the boundary, relevant to zero variance components and regularity assumptions.
limitation_for_drmTMB: General boundary theory; it does not provide a package-specific interval method or calibration result.

citation: Bates D, Mächler M, Bolker B, Walker S. Fitting Linear Mixed-Effects Models Using lme4. Journal of Statistical Software 67(1):1-48.
specific_support: Explains likelihood representation, optimization, parameter structures, and implementation of linear mixed models; supports lme4 as a carefully scoped Gaussian comparator.
limitation_for_drmTMB: Primarily linear Gaussian mixed models; estimates are not a universal oracle for generalized models or differently approximated marginal likelihoods.
